feed.title: VERAQIS Research
feed.subtitle: Measurements of what is and is not recoverable from damaged files, including the negative results.

entry.title: Bit flip in a solid 7z archive: what survives
entry.summary: We flipped one bit at six depths in a real 541-file solid 7z archive and counted what still decodes byte-exact: 87 to 501 files recovered, zero false files.

entry.title: The joint-verifier surface is empty — 12 formats
entry.summary: Can independent checksums be combined to solve for lost bytes? We measured 12 file formats: the joint-sufficient share is 0.00 in every one, so the solver was cancelled.

entry.title: Recovering past corruption in xz and bzip2
entry.summary: Stock xz -d abandons a whole stream on one bad block. We measured block-independent salvage: 9 of 10 blocks recovered, each CRC-verified, zero false bytes.

entry.title: CRC-32 collisions that pass gzip -t and unzip -t
entry.summary: We built files with different contents and identical CRC-32 that pass gzip -t and unzip -t. What a passing checksum proves, what it cannot, and what closes the gap.
